title: Five Roll Outcomes
hook: Every action roll resolves into one of five table results: critical success, success with Hope, success with Fear, failure with Hope, or failure with Fear.

blocks.label: What It Is
blocks.body: Every action roll resolves into one of five table results: critical success, success with Hope, success with Fear, failure with Hope, or failure with Fear.

blocks.label: How It Works
blocks.body: Critical Success; Success with Hope; Success with Fear; Failure with Hope; Failure with Fear.

affordances: Check doubles first for Critical Success.
If not a critical, compare total to Difficulty.
At or above Difficulty succeeds; below Difficulty fails.
Hope spin gives Hope and a cleaner/kinder edge; Fear spin gives the GM Fear and a cost or complication.
